claim_boundary: Designed for low interaction cost; not proven fastest until the usability benchmark passes.
design_rule: Ask only questions that change the platform structure or its risk controls.

controls.personal_data: ask collection and retention details only when applicable
controls.permissions: ask role boundaries only when applicable
controls.payment: sandbox only until separate financial approval
controls.single_source_exception: allowed only after rights review, owner scope approval, clean-room implementation, distinctions in at least two categories including one functional distinction, and similarity review
